                self._progress_cb("  🌐 Probing live URL…")
                runtime_evidence = await self._http_client.probe(
                    bug.runtime_evidence[0].endpoint if bug.runtime_evidence else None  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                )
                subagent_outputs["runtime_evidence"] = runtime_evidence.model_dump()

            # ── b. Reproducer ‖ CauseTracer (parallel) ────────────────────
            self._progress_cb("  🔍 Running Reproducer + CauseTracer in parallel…")
            failing_test, root_cause = await self._reproduce_and_trace(
                bug=bug,
                runtime_evidence=runtime_evidence,
                prior_failure=prior_failure,
            )
            subagent_outputs["failing_test"] = {"file": failing_test.file, "code": failing_test.code}
            subagent_outputs["root_cause"] = root_cause.model_dump()
            self._report_builder.set_root_cause(root_cause)

            # ── c. Write & run the repro test ────────────────────────────
            self._progress_cb("  🧪 Writing and running repro test…")
            proj_root = project_root(codebases)
            repro_file_path = proj_root / failing_test.file
            repro_file_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            repro_file_path.write_text(failing_test.code, encoding="utf-8")

            repro_result = self._test_runner.run_single(repro_file_path)
            if repro_result.passed:
                # Test passes → bug not observable (E9)
                _safe_delete(repro_file_path)
                repro_file_path = None
                raise BugNotObservable(
                    "Reproducer's failing test passed on current code — bug not observable"
                )

            # ── d. Confidence check ───────────────────────────────────────
            if root_cause.confidence < CONFIDENCE_FLOOR:
                self._progress_cb(
                    f"  ⚠️  Confidence {root_cause.confidence:.2f} < {CONFIDENCE_FLOOR} (E5)"
                )
                attempt = Attempt(
                    num=attempt_num,
                    subagent_outputs=subagent_outputs,
                    failure_reason=f"Confidence {root_cause.confidence:.2f} below floor {CONFIDENCE_FLOOR}",
                )
                _safe_delete(repro_file_path)
                return attempt, ReportStatus.NEEDS_HUMAN, None

            # ── e. FixAuthor + Adjudication ───────────────────────────────
            self._progress_cb("  ✏️  Running FixAuthor…")
            fix_author = self._factory.make_fix_author()
            candidates = await fix_author.run(root_cause=root_cause, prior_failure=prior_failure)
            subagent_outputs["fix_candidates"] = len(candidates)

            approved_fix, adjudications, last_reasoning = await self._select_approved_fix(
                root_cause=root_cause, candidates=candidates
            )
            for adj in adjudications:
                self._report_builder.add_adjudication(adj)

            if approved_fix is None:
                self._progress_cb("  ❌ All fix candidates rejected")
                attempt = Attempt(
                    num=attempt_num,
                    subagent_outputs=subagent_outputs,
                    failure_reason=last_reasoning or "All candidates rejected",
                )
                _safe_delete(repro_file_path)
                return attempt, None, None  # try next attempt

            subagent_outputs["approved_fix"] = approved_fix.target_codebase

            # ── f. dry-run: stop here ─────────────────────────────────────
            if self._dry_run:
                self._progress_cb("  🌵 --dry-run: stopping before apply")
                self._report_builder.set_fix(approved_fix)
                attempt = Attempt(
                    num=attempt_num,
                    subagent_outputs=subagent_outputs,
                )
                _safe_delete(repro_file_path)
                return attempt, ReportStatus.PARTIAL, None

            # ── g. Guard + apply ──────────────────────────────────────────
            self._progress_cb("  🛡  Running Guard…")
            guard = self._factory.make_guard()
            regression_test = await guard.run(root_cause=root_cause, fix=approved_fix)
            subagent_outputs["regression_test"] = regression_test.file

            regression_file_path = proj_root / regression_test.file
            regression_file_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            regression_file_path.write_text(regression_test.code, encoding="utf-8")

            # Apply the fix
            target_codebase = _find_codebase(codebases, approved_fix.target_codebase)
            self._progress_cb("  🔧 Applying fix…")
            self._git_ops.apply_fix(target_codebase, approved_fix)

            # ── h. Run tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────
            self._progress_cb("  🧪 Running full test suite…")
            test_result = self._test_runner.run(codebases)

            if test_result.passed:
                # Delete the repro test before committing (it must not be permanent)
                _safe_delete(repro_file_path)
                repro_file_path = None

                self._progress_cb("  ✅ Tests passed — committing…")
                self._report_builder.set_fix(approved_fix)
                self._report_builder.set_regression_test(regression_test)
                commit_sha = self._git_ops.commit(
                    target_codebase, approved_fix, regression_test, proj_root
                )
                attempt = Attempt(
                    num=attempt_num,
                    subagent_outputs=subagent_outputs,
                    test_result=test_result,
                )
                return attempt, ReportStatus.FIXED, commit_sha
            else:
                # Tests failed — revert and record failure
                self._progress_cb("  ❌ Tests failed — reverting fix…")
                self._git_ops.revert_fix(target_codebase, approved_fix)
                failure_reason = f"Tests failed: {', '.join(test_result.failed_tests[:5])}"
                attempt = Attempt(
                    num=attempt_num,
                    subagent_outputs=subagent_outputs,
                    test_result=test_result,
                    failure_reason=failure_reason,
                )
                _safe_delete(repro_file_path)
                _safe_delete(regression_file_path)
                repro_file_path = None
                regression_file_path = None
                return attempt, None, None  # try next attempt

        except BugNotObservable as exc:
            self._progress_cb(f"  ⚠️  Bug not observable (E9): {exc}")
            attempt = Attempt(
                num=attempt_num,
                subagent_outputs=subagent_outputs,
                failure_reason=str(exc),
            )
            return attempt, ReportStatus.NEEDS_HUMAN, None

        except BudgetExhausted as exc:
            self._progress_cb(f"  💰 Budget exhausted (E4): {exc}")
            attempt = Attempt(
                num=attempt_num,
                subagent_outputs=subagent_outputs,
                failure_reason=str(exc),
            )
            return attempt, ReportStatus.PARTIAL, None

        except MissingCodebaseError as exc:
            self._progress_cb(f"  ⚠️  Missing codebase (E10): {exc}")
            attempt = Attempt(
                num=attempt_num,
                subagent_outputs=subagent_outputs,
                failure_reason=str(exc),
            )
            return attempt, ReportStatus.NEEDS_HUMAN, None

        except (SubagentError, BobShellError) as exc:
            self._progress_cb(f"  ⚠️  Subagent error: {exc}")
            attempt = Attempt(
                num=attempt_num,
                subagent_outputs=subagent_outputs,
                failure_reason=str(exc),
            )
            return attempt, None, None  # try next attempt

        finally:
            # Always delete temporary test files, even on errors
            _safe_delete(repro_file_path)
            _safe_delete(regression_file_path)

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Parallel Reproducer + CauseTracer
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    async def _reproduce_and_trace(
        self,
        bug: Bug,
        runtime_evidence: RuntimeEvidence | None,
        prior_failure: str | None,
    ) -> tuple[FailingTest, RootCause]:
        """Run Reproducer and CauseTracer concurrently via anyio (the only parallel step)."""
        failing_test_holder: list[FailingTest] = []
        root_cause_holder: list[RootCause] = []

        reproducer = self._factory.make_reproducer()
        cause_tracer = self._factory.make_cause_tracer()

        async def run_reproducer() -> None:
            result = await reproducer.run(
                bug=bug,
                runtime_evidence=runtime_evidence,
                prior_failure=prior_failure,
            )
            failing_test_holder.append(result)

        async def run_cause_tracer() -> None:
            result = await cause_tracer.run(
                bug=bug,
                runtime_evidence=runtime_evidence,
                prior_failure=prior_failure,
            )
            root_cause_holder.append(result)

        async with anyio.create_task_group() as tg:
            tg.start_soon(run_reproducer)
            tg.start_soon(run_cause_tracer)

        return failing_test_holder[0], root_cause_holder[0]

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Adjudication
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    async def _select_approved_fix(
        self,
        root_cause: RootCause,
        candidates: list[Fix],
    ) -> tuple[Fix | None, list[Adjudication], str | None]:
        """
        Adjudicate candidates lowest-risk first.
        Returns (first_approved_fix_or_None, all_adjudications, last_reasoning).
        """
        adjudications: list[Adjudication] = []
        last_reasoning: str | None = None

        for candidate in candidates:
            adj = await self._adjudicate(root_cause, candidate)
            if adj is not None:
                adjudications.append(adj)
                last_reasoning = adj.reasoning
                if adj.verdict == AdjudicationVerdict.APPROVE:
                    return candidate, adjudications, last_reasoning
            else:
                # Watsonx not configured / error → fail-open: take this candidate
                self._progress_cb("  ⚠️  Adjudicator unavailable — failing open")
                return candidate, adjudications, None

        return None, adjudications, last_reasoning

    async def _adjudicate(
        self,
        root_cause: RootCause,
        fix: Fix,
    ) -> Adjudication | None:
        """
        Await WatsonxClient.adjudicate; return None on any WatsonxError or if not configured.
        Calls report_builder.set_adjudicator_available(False) when returning None.
        """
        if not self._watsonx.is_configured():
            self._report_builder.set_adjudicator_available(False)
            return None

        source_context = self._build_source_context(root_cause)
        try:
            return await self._watsonx.adjudicate(root_cause, fix, source_context)
        except WatsonxError:
            self._report_builder.set_adjudicator_available(False)
            return None

    def _build_source_context(self, root_cause: RootCause) -> str:
        """Assemble redacted source context lines around root_cause.file:line."""
        try:
            abs_path = self._workspace.resolve_file(root_cause.codebase, root_cause.file)
            lines = abs_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
            start = max(0, root_cause.line - 10)
            end = min(len(lines), root_cause.line + 10)
            context_lines = lines[start:end]
            return "\n".join(context_lines)
        except (KeyError, OSError):
            return ""


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _safe_delete(path: Path | None) -> None:
    """Delete a file if it exists; silently ignore errors."""
    if path is None:
        return
    try:
        if path.exists():
            path.unlink()
    except OSError:
        pass


def _find_codebase(codebases: list[SourceCodebase], name: str) -> SourceCodebase:
    """Find a codebase by name; raise MissingCodebaseError if not found."""
    for cb in codebases:
        if cb.name == name:
            return cb
    raise MissingCodebaseError(
        f"Codebase '{name}' not found in workspace. Available: "
        + ", ".join(cb.name for cb in codebases)
    )

"""
Culprit CLI entry point (§2).

Defines the `culprit debug` Click command. Parses and validates CLI flags,
loads .env, instantiates infrastructure objects, delegates entirely to
Orchestrator, and renders the CulpritReport to the terminal via Rich.

This file contains NO business logic. It is a pure presentation layer.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

import anyio
import click
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from rich.console import Console
from rich.panel import Panel
from rich.syntax import Syntax
from rich.table import Table
from rich import box

from culprit.config import MAX_BOBCOIN_PER_RUN, MAX_CODEBASES, MAX_URLS
from culprit.domain.exceptions import AuthError, UnreachableError
from culprit.domain.models import AuthScheme, Bug, CulpritReport, Endpoint, ReportStatus, SourceCodebase
from culprit.infrastructure.auth import AuthBuilder
from culprit.infrastructure.bob_client import BobClient
from culprit.infrastructure.git_ops import GitOps
from culprit.infrastructure.http_client import HttpClient
from culprit.infrastructure.test_runner import TestRunner
from culprit.infrastructure.watsonx_client import WatsonxClient
from culprit.infrastructure.workspace import Workspace
from culprit.subagents.factory import SubagentFactory
from culprit.application.orchestrator import Orchestrator
from culprit.application.report_builder import ReportBuilder

console = Console()


@click.group()
def cli() -> None:
    """Culprit — AI-powered backend debugger."""


@cli.command("debug")
@click.argument("inputs", nargs=-1)
@click.option("--issue", required=True, help="Bug description.")
@click.option("--url", multiple=True, help="Live endpoint URL (repeatable, max 3).")
@click.option(
    "--folder",
    multiple=True,
    type=click.Path(exists=True),
    help="Local code folder (repeatable, 1-6).",
)
@click.option("--git", "git_urls", multiple=True, help="Remote repo to clone (repeatable, 1-4).")
@click.option(
    "--trace",
    type=click.Path(exists=True),
    default=None,
    help="Path to stack trace or error log.",
)
@click.option(
    "--auth-bearer",
    "auth_scheme",
    flag_value="BEARER",
    help="Read BEARER_TOKEN from .env.",
)
@click.option(
    "--auth-basic",
    "auth_scheme",
    flag_value="BASIC",
    help="Read BASIC_USER, BASIC_PASS from .env.",
)
@click.option(
    "--auth-oauth2",
    "auth_scheme",
    flag_value="OAUTH2",
    help="Read OAUTH_* vars from .env.",
)
@click.option(
    "--auth-apikey",
    "auth_scheme",
    flag_value="APIKEY",
    help="Read API_KEY, API_KEY_HEADER from .env.",
)
@click.option(
    "--no-auth",
    "auth_scheme",
    flag_value="NONE",
    help="Explicit for public endpoints.",
)
@click.option(
    "--dry-run",
    is_flag=True,
    default=False,
    help="Analyze only; no fix applied, no commit.",
)
def debug_command(
    inputs: tuple[str, ...],
    issue: str,
    url: tuple[str, ...],
    folder: tuple[str, ...],
    git_urls: tuple[str, ...],
    trace: Optional[str],
    auth_scheme: Optional[str],
    dry_run: bool,
) -> None:
    """
    Debug a live backend service and attempt an automated fix.

    Validates flag counts against MAX_URLS and MAX_CODEBASES, builds
    infrastructure objects, and delegates to Orchestrator.run().
    Renders the CulpritReport with Rich on completion.
    """
    # Load .env silently (never print its contents)
    load_dotenv(override=False)

    # ── Validate counts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if len(url) > MAX_URLS:
        raise click.UsageError(f"Too many --url flags (max {MAX_URLS})")
    if len(folder) > MAX_CODEBASES:
        raise click.UsageError(f"Too many --folder flags (max {MAX_CODEBASES})")
    if not folder and not git_urls:
        raise click.UsageError("At least one --folder or --git source is required")

    # ── Build workspace ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    import tempfile
    work_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="culprit_"))
    workspace = Workspace(work_dir=work_dir)
    for idx, f in enumerate(folder):
        name = Path(f).name or f"codebase_{idx}"
        workspace.load_folder(Path(f), name)

    codebases = workspace.get_codebases()

    # ── Build auth context ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    scheme = AuthScheme(auth_scheme) if auth_scheme else AuthScheme.NONE
    http_client: HttpClient | None = None
    if url:
        try:
            auth_context = AuthBuilder().build(scheme)
        except (AuthError, NotImplementedError) as exc:
            console.print(f"[red]Auth error:[/red] {exc}")
            sys.exit(1)
        endpoint = Endpoint(
            url=url[0],
            method="GET",
            headers={},
            expected_status=200,
        )
        http_client = HttpClient(auth_context)
        # Embed the endpoint into the bug so the orchestrator can probe it
        from culprit.domain.models import RuntimeEvidence
        # We'll pass the endpoint through the bug static_evidence; the probe
        # is done in the orchestrator step (a).
    else:
        auth_context = None

    # ── Build domain Bug ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    static_evidence = list(codebases)
    bug = Bug(
        description=issue,
        runtime_evidence=[],
        static_evidence=static_evidence,
    )

    # ── Wire infrastructure ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    bob_client = BobClient(
        workspace_root=work_dir,
        max_bobcoins=MAX_BOBCOIN_PER_RUN,
    )
    factory = SubagentFactory(workspace, bob_client)
    watsonx_client = WatsonxClient()
    test_runner = TestRunner()
    git_ops = GitOps()
    report_builder = ReportBuilder(bug)

    # ── Progress callback using Rich ──────────────────────────────────────
    run_start = time.monotonic()

    def progress(msg: str) -> None:
        elapsed = time.monotonic() - run_start
        console.print(f"[dim]{elapsed:6.1f}s[/dim]  {msg}")

    orchestrator = Orchestrator(
        workspace=workspace,
        factory=factory,
        watsonx_client=watsonx_client,
        test_runner=test_runner,
        git_ops=git_ops,
        http_client=http_client,
        report_builder=report_builder,
        dry_run=dry_run,
        progress_cb=progress,
    )

    # ── Run ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    try:
        report: CulpritReport = anyio.from_thread.run_sync(
            lambda: anyio.run(orchestrator.run, bug)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        )
    except Exception:
        report = anyio.run(orchestrator.run, bug)

    # ── Render final report ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    _render_report(report, run_start)

    exit_code = 0 if report.status == ReportStatus.FIXED else 1
    sys.exit(exit_code)


def _render_report(report: CulpritReport, run_start: float) -> None:
    """Render the final CulpritReport to the terminal using Rich."""
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - run_start

    status_color = {
        ReportStatus.FIXED: "green",
        ReportStatus.PARTIAL: "yellow",
        ReportStatus.NEEDS_HUMAN: "red",
    }.get(report.status, "white")

    console.print()
    console.rule("[bold]Culprit Report[/bold]")

    # Status
    console.print(f"  Status:       [{status_color}]{report.status.value}[/{status_color}]")
    console.print(f"  Elapsed:      {elapsed:.1f}s")
    console.print(f"  Bobcoins:     {report.bobcoins_used:.4f}")

    # Root cause
    if report.root_cause:
        rc = report.root_cause
        console.print(
            f"  Root cause:   {rc.file}:{rc.line}  [{rc.codebase}]  "
            f"confidence={rc.confidence:.0%}"
        )
        console.print(f"                {rc.explanation}")

    # Fix diff
    if report.fix and report.fix.unified_diff:
        console.print()
        console.print(
            Panel(
                Syntax(report.fix.unified_diff, "diff", theme="monokai", line_numbers=False),
                title="Fix diff",
                border_style="green",
            )
        )

    # Adjudication table
    if report.adjudications:
        table = Table(title="Adjudication scores", box=box.SIMPLE)
        table.add_column("#", style="dim")
        table.add_column("Correctness")
        table.add_column("Safety")
        table.add_column("Minimalism")
        table.add_column("Total")
        table.add_column("Verdict")
        for i, adj in enumerate(report.adjudications, 1):
            verdict_style = "green" if adj.verdict.value == "APPROVE" else "red"
            table.add_row(
                str(i),
                f"{adj.correctness_score:.2f}",
                f"{adj.safety_score:.2f}",
                f"{adj.minimalism_score:.2f}",
                f"{adj.total_score:.2f}",
                f"[{verdict_style}]{adj.verdict.value}[/{verdict_style}]",
            )
        console.print(table)
    elif not report.adjudicator_available:
        console.print("  Adjudicator:  [dim]watsonx not configured[/dim]")

    # Test result
    if report.attempts:
        last = report.attempts[-1]
        if last.test_result:
            tr = last.test_result
            tr_color = "green" if tr.passed else "red"
            console.print(f"  Tests:        [{tr_color}]{'PASSED' if tr.passed else 'FAILED'}[/{tr_color}]")

    # Commit SHA
    commit_sha = getattr(report, "_commit_sha", None)
    if commit_sha:
        console.print(f"  Commit SHA:   {commit_sha}")

    console.print()

from rich.panel import Panel

from culprit.config import MAX_BOBCOIN_PER_RUN, MAX_CODEBASES, MAX_URLS
from culprit.domain.exceptions import AuthError, UnreachableError
from culprit.domain.models import AuthScheme, Bug, CulpritReport, Endpoint, ReportStatus, SourceCodebase
from culprit.infrastructure.auth import AuthBuilder
from culprit.infrastructure.bob_client import BobClient
from culprit.infrastructure.git_ops import GitOps
from culprit.infrastructure.http_client import HttpClient
from culprit.infrastructure.test_runner import TestRunner
from culprit.infrastructure.watsonx_client import WatsonxClient
from culprit.infrastructure.workspace import Workspace
from culprit.subagents.factory import SubagentFactory
from culprit.application.orchestrator import Orchestrator
from culprit.application.report_builder import ReportBuilder

console = Console()


@click.group()
def cli() -> None:
    """Culprit — AI-powered backend debugger."""


@cli.command("debug")
@click.argument("inputs", nargs=-1)
@click.option("--issue", required=True, help="Bug description.")
@click.option("--url", multiple=True, help="Live endpoint URL (repeatable, max 3).")
@click.option(
    "--folder",
    multiple=True,
    type=click.Path(exists=True),
    help="Local code folder (repeatable, 1-6).",

@click.option("--git", "git_urls", multiple=True, help="Remote repo to clone (repeatable, 1-4).")
@click.option(

    default=None,
    help="Path to stack trace or error log.",

@click.option(

    "auth_scheme",
    flag_value="BEARER",
    help="Read BEARER_TOKEN from .env.",
)
@click.option(

    "auth_scheme",
    flag_value="BASIC",
    help="Read BASIC_USER, BASIC_PASS from .env.",
)
@click.option(

    "auth_scheme",
    flag_value="OAUTH2",
    help="Read OAUTH_* vars from .env.",
)
@click.option(
    "--auth-apikey",
    "auth_scheme",
    flag_value="APIKEY",
    help="Read API_KEY, API_KEY_HEADER from .env.",
)
@click.option(
    "--no-auth",
    "auth_scheme",
    flag_value="NONE",
    help="Explicit for public endpoints.",
)
@click.option(
    "--dry-run",
    is_flag=True,
    default=False,
    help="Analyze only; no fix applied, no commit.",
)
def debug_command(
    inputs: tuple[str, ...],
    issue: str,
    url: tuple[str, ...],
    folder: tuple[str, ...],
    git_urls: tuple[str, ...],
    trace: Optional[str],
    auth_scheme: Optional[str],
    dry_run: bool,
) -> None:
    """
    Debug a live backend service and attempt an automated fix.

    Validates flag counts against MAX_URLS and MAX_CODEBASES, builds
    infrastructure objects, and delegates to Orchestrator.run().
    Renders the CulpritReport with Rich on completion.
    """

    load_dotenv(override=False)

    # ── Validate counts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if len(url) > MAX_URLS:
        raise click.UsageError(f"Too many --url flags (max {MAX_URLS})")
    if len(folder) > MAX_CODEBASES:
        raise click.UsageError(f"Too many --folder flags (max {MAX_CODEBASES})")

    workspace = Workspace(work_dir=work_dir)
    for idx, f in enumerate(folder):
        name = Path(f).name or f"codebase_{idx}"
        workspace.load_folder(Path(f), name)

    codebases = workspace.get_codebases()

    scheme = AuthScheme(auth_scheme) if auth_scheme else AuthScheme.NONE
    http_client: HttpClient | None = None
    if url:
        try:
            auth_context = AuthBuilder().build(scheme)
        except (AuthError, NotImplementedError) as exc:
            console.print(f"[red]Auth error:[/red] {exc}")
            sys.exit(1)
        endpoint = Endpoint(
            url=url[0],
            method="GET",
            headers={},
            expected_status=200,
        )
        http_client = HttpClient(auth_context)
        # Embed the endpoint into the bug so the orchestrator can probe it
        from culprit.domain.models import RuntimeEvidence
        # We'll pass the endpoint through the bug static_evidence; the probe
        # is done in the orchestrator step (a).

        auth_context = None

    bug = Bug(
        description=issue,
        runtime_evidence=[],
        static_evidence=static_evidence,
    )

    # ── Wire infrastructure ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    bob_client = BobClient(
        workspace_root=work_dir,
        max_bobcoins=MAX_BOBCOIN_PER_RUN,
    )
    factory = SubagentFactory(workspace, bob_client)
    watsonx_client = WatsonxClient()
    test_runner = TestRunner()
    git_ops = GitOps()
    report_builder = ReportBuilder(bug)

    # ── Progress callback using Rich ──────────────────────────────────────
    run_start = time.monotonic()

    def progress(msg: str) -> None:
        elapsed = time.monotonic() - run_start
        console.print(f"[dim]{elapsed:6.1f}s[/dim]  {msg}")

    orchestrator = Orchestrator(
        workspace=workspace,
        factory=factory,
        watsonx_client=watsonx_client,
        test_runner=test_runner,
        git_ops=git_ops,
        http_client=http_client,
        report_builder=report_builder,
        dry_run=dry_run,
        progress_cb=progress,
    )

    # ── Run ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    try:
        report: CulpritReport = anyio.from_thread.run_sync(
            lambda: anyio.run(orchestrator.run, bug)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        )
    except Exception:
        report = anyio.run(orchestrator.run, bug)

    # ── Render final report ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    _render_report(report, run_start)

    exit_code = 0 if report.status == ReportStatus.FIXED else 1
    sys.exit(exit_code)


def _render_report(report: CulpritReport, run_start: float) -> None:
    """Render the final CulpritReport to the terminal using Rich."""
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - run_start

    status_color = {
        ReportStatus.FIXED: "green",
        ReportStatus.PARTIAL: "yellow",
        ReportStatus.NEEDS_HUMAN: "red",
    }.get(report.status, "white")

    console.print()
    console.rule("[bold]Culprit Report[/bold]")

    # Status
    console.print(f"  Status:       [{status_color}]{report.status.value}[/{status_color}]")
    console.print(f"  Elapsed:      {elapsed:.1f}s")
    console.print(f"  Bobcoins:     {report.bobcoins_used:.4f}")

    # Root cause
    if report.root_cause:
        rc = report.root_cause
        console.print(
            f"  Root cause:   {rc.file}:{rc.line}  [{rc.codebase}]  "
            f"confidence={rc.confidence:.0%}"
        )
        console.print(f"                {rc.explanation}")

    # Fix diff
    if report.fix and report.fix.unified_diff:
        console.print()
        console.print(
            Panel(
                Syntax(report.fix.unified_diff, "diff", theme="monokai", line_numbers=False),
                title="Fix diff",
                border_style="green",
            )
        )

    # Adjudication table
    if report.adjudications:
        table = Table(title="Adjudication scores", box=box.SIMPLE)
        table.add_column("#", style="dim")
        table.add_column("Correctness")
        table.add_column("Safety")
        table.add_column("Minimalism")
        table.add_column("Total")
        table.add_column("Verdict")
        for i, adj in enumerate(report.adjudications, 1):
            verdict_style = "green" if adj.verdict.value == "APPROVE" else "red"
            table.add_row(
                str(i),
                f"{adj.correctness_score:.2f}",
                f"{adj.safety_score:.2f}",
                f"{adj.minimalism_score:.2f}",
                f"{adj.total_score:.2f}",
                f"[{verdict_style}]{adj.verdict.value}[/{verdict_style}]",
            )
        console.print(table)
    elif not report.adjudicator_available:
        console.print("  Adjudicator:  [dim]watsonx not configured[/dim]")

    # Test result
    if report.attempts:
        last = report.attempts[-1]
        if last.test_result:
            tr = last.test_result
            tr_color = "green" if tr.passed else "red"
            console.print(f"  Tests:        [{tr_color}]{'PASSED' if tr.passed else 'FAILED'}[/{tr_color}]")

    # Commit SHA
    commit_sha = getattr(report, "_commit_sha", None)
    if commit_sha:
        console.print(f"  Commit SHA:   {commit_sha}")

    console.print()

+    # ── Wire infrastructure ────────────────────────────────────────────────
+    bob_client = BobClient(
+        workspace_root=work_dir,
+        max_bobcoins=MAX_BOBCOIN_PER_RUN,
+    )
+    factory = SubagentFactory(workspace, bob_client)
+    watsonx_client = WatsonxClient()
+    test_runner = TestRunner()
+    git_ops = GitOps()
+    report_builder = ReportBuilder(bug)
+
+    # ── Progress callback using Rich ──────────────────────────────────────
+    run_start = time.monotonic()
+
+    def progress(msg: str) -> None:
+        elapsed = time.monotonic() - run_start
+        console.print(f"[dim]{elapsed:6.1f}s[/dim]  {msg}")
+
+    orchestrator = Orchestrator(
+        workspace=workspace,
+        factory=factory,
+        watsonx_client=watsonx_client,
+        test_runner=test_runner,
+        git_ops=git_ops,
+        http_client=http_client,
+        report_builder=report_builder,
+        dry_run=dry_run,
+        progress_cb=progress,
+    )
+
+    # ── Run ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+    try:
+        report: CulpritReport = anyio.from_thread.run_sync(
+            lambda: anyio.run(orchestrator.run, bug)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+        )
+    except Exception:
+        report = anyio.run(orchestrator.run, bug)
+
+    # ── Render final report ───────────────────────────────────────────────
+    _render_report(report, run_start)
+
+    exit_code = 0 if report.status == ReportStatus.FIXED else 1
+    sys.exit(exit_code)
+
+
+def _render_report(report: CulpritReport, run_start: float) -> None:
+    """Render the final CulpritReport to the terminal using Rich."""
+    elapsed = time.monotonic() - run_start
+
+    status_color = {
+        ReportStatus.FIXED: "green",
+        ReportStatus.PARTIAL: "yellow",
+        ReportStatus.NEEDS_HUMAN: "red",
+    }.get(report.status, "white")
+
+    console.print()
+    console.rule("[bold]Culprit Report[/bold]")
+
+    # Status
+    console.print(f"  Status:       [{status_color}]{report.status.value}[/{status_color}]")
+    console.print(f"  Elapsed:      {elapsed:.1f}s")
+    console.print(f"  Bobcoins:     {report.bobcoins_used:.4f}")
+
+    # Root cause
+    if report.root_cause:
+        rc = report.root_cause
+        console.print(
+            f"  Root cause:   {rc.file}:{rc.line}  [{rc.codebase}]  "
+            f"confidence={rc.confidence:.0%}"
+        )
+        console.print(f"                {rc.explanation}")
+
+    # Fix diff
+    if report.fix and report.fix.unified_diff:
+        console.print()
+        console.print(
+            Panel(
+                Syntax(report.fix.unified_diff, "diff", theme="monokai", line_numbers=False),
+                title="Fix diff",
+                border_style="green",
+            )
+        )
+
+    # Adjudication table
+    if report.adjudications:
+        table = Table(title="Adjudication scores", box=box.SIMPLE)
+        table.add_column("#", style="dim")
+        table.add_column("Correctness")
+        table.add_column("Safety")
+        table.add_column("Minimalism")
+        table.add_column("Total")
+        table.add_column("Verdict")
+        for i, adj in enumerate(report.adjudications, 1):
+            verdict_style = "green" if adj.verdict.value == "APPROVE" else "red"
+            table.add_row(
+                str(i),
+                f"{adj.correctness_score:.2f}",
+                f"{adj.safety_score:.2f}",
+                f"{adj.minimalism_score:.2f}",
+                f"{adj.total_score:.2f}",
+                f"[{verdict_style}]{adj.verdict.value}[/{verdict_style}]",
+            )
+        console.print(table)
+    elif not report.adjudicator_available:
+        console.print("  Adjudicator:  [dim]watsonx not configured[/dim]")
+
+    # Test result
+    if report.attempts:
+        last = report.attempts[-1]
+        if last.test_result:
+            tr = last.test_result
+            tr_color = "green" if tr.passed else "red"
+            console.print(f"  Tests:        [{tr_color}]{'PASSED' if tr.passed else 'FAILED'}[/{tr_color}]")
+
+    # Commit SHA
+    commit_sha = getattr(report, "_commit_sha", None)
+    if commit_sha:
+        console.print(f"  Commit SHA:   {commit_sha}")
+
+    console.print()

"""
Tests for the Orchestrator (new Part 4).

Fake subagents / fake watsonx / fake GitOps — no real Bob, no network.
Covers:
  - FIXED path: repro fails → confidence OK → adjudicate APPROVE → tests pass → commit
  - E9 path: repro test passes on current code → NEEDS_HUMAN
  - E5 path: confidence below floor → NEEDS_HUMAN
  - REJECT-all path: all candidates rejected → loops, exhausts attempts → NEEDS_HUMAN
  - Fail-open path: watsonx not configured → take candidate 0 → FIXED
  - dry-run: adjudicate runs but nothing applied or committed
  - Temp test files are always deleted even on errors
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock, patch, call

import pytest
import anyio

from culprit.application.orchestrator import Orchestrator
from culprit.application.report_builder import ReportBuilder
from culprit.config import CONFIDENCE_FLOOR
from culprit.domain.exceptions import SubagentError, WatsonxError
from culprit.domain.models import (
    Adjudication,
    AdjudicationVerdict,
    Bug,
    FileEdit,
    Fix,
    RegressionTest,
    ReportStatus,
    RootCause,
    SourceCodebase,
    TestResult,
)
from culprit.infrastructure.git_ops import GitOps
from culprit.infrastructure.test_runner import TestRunner
from culprit.infrastructure.watsonx_client import WatsonxClient
from culprit.infrastructure.workspace import Workspace
from culprit.subagents.factory import SubagentFactory
from culprit.subagents.reproducer import FailingTest


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared test fixtures and factories
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

@pytest.fixture()
def tmp_project(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    """A minimal project root with a tests/ folder."""
    (tmp_path / "tests").mkdir()
    return tmp_path


@pytest.fixture()
def workspace(tmp_project: Path) -> Workspace:
    ws = Workspace(work_dir=tmp_project)
    cb_dir = tmp_project / "myapp"
    cb_dir.mkdir()
    (cb_dir / "app.py").write_text("total = price - discount\n")
    (cb_dir / "tests").mkdir()
    ws.load_folder(cb_dir, "myapp")
    return ws


@pytest.fixture()
def bug() -> Bug:
    return Bug(
        description="cart total wrong",
        runtime_evidence=[],
        static_evidence=[],
    )


@pytest.fixture()
def root_cause() -> RootCause:
    return RootCause(
        codebase="myapp",
        file="app.py",
        line=1,
        symbol="total",
        explanation="discount applied before tax",
        confidence=0.92,
    )


@pytest.fixture()
def good_fix() -> Fix:
    return Fix(
        target_codebase="myapp",
        edits=[FileEdit(file="app.py", old_text="total = price - discount", new_text="total = price * 1.1 - discount")],
    )


@pytest.fixture()
def regression_test_obj() -> RegressionTest:
    return RegressionTest(
        codebase="myapp",
        file="tests/test_culprit_regression.py",
        test_name="test_discount_after_tax",
        code="def test_discount_after_tax():\n    assert True\n",
    )


@pytest.fixture()
def failing_test_obj() -> FailingTest:
    return FailingTest(
        file="tests/test_culprit_repro.py",
        code="def test_repro():\n    assert False\n",
    )


def _approve_adjudication() -> Adjudication:
    return Adjudication(
        correctness_score=0.9,
        safety_score=0.9,
        minimalism_score=0.9,
        total_score=0.9,
        verdict=AdjudicationVerdict.APPROVE,
        reasoning="Looks good",
    )


def _reject_adjudication() -> Adjudication:
    return Adjudication(
        correctness_score=0.3,
        safety_score=0.3,
        minimalism_score=0.3,
        total_score=0.3,
        verdict=AdjudicationVerdict.REJECT,
        reasoning="Dangerous change",
    )


def _make_orchestrator(
    workspace: Workspace,
    bug: Bug,
    *,
    failing_test: FailingTest,
    root_cause: RootCause,
    fixes: list[Fix],
    regression_test: RegressionTest,
    repro_passes: bool = False,   # True → E9
    tests_pass: bool = True,
    watsonx_configured: bool = True,
    watsonx_verdict: AdjudicationVerdict = AdjudicationVerdict.APPROVE,
    watsonx_raises: bool = False,
    dry_run: bool = False,
    tmp_path: Path | None = None,
) -> tuple[Orchestrator, MagicMock, MagicMock, MagicMock]:
    """
    Build an Orchestrator with all dependencies mocked.
    Returns (orchestrator, mock_factory, mock_git_ops, mock_test_runner).
    """
    # --- Fake factory with async subagents ---
    mock_reproducer = MagicMock()
    mock_reproducer.run = AsyncMock(return_value=failing_test)

    mock_cause_tracer = MagicMock()
    mock_cause_tracer.run = AsyncMock(return_value=root_cause)

    mock_fix_author = MagicMock()
    mock_fix_author.run = AsyncMock(return_value=fixes)

    mock_guard = MagicMock()
    mock_guard.run = AsyncMock(return_value=regression_test)

    mock_factory = MagicMock(spec=SubagentFactory)
    mock_factory.make_reproducer.return_value = mock_reproducer
    mock_factory.make_cause_tracer.return_value = mock_cause_tracer
    mock_factory.make_fix_author.return_value = mock_fix_author
    mock_factory.make_guard.return_value = mock_guard

    # make_reproducer()._bob_client.get_bobcoins_used() for cost tracking
    mock_reproducer._bob_client = MagicMock()
    mock_reproducer._bob_client.get_bobcoins_used.return_value = 0.5

    # --- Fake git ops ---
    mock_git_ops = MagicMock(spec=GitOps)
    mock_git_ops.apply_fix.return_value = None
    mock_git_ops.revert_fix.return_value = None
    mock_git_ops.commit.return_value = "abc1234deadbeef"

    # --- Fake test runner ---
    repro_result = TestResult(
        passed=repro_passes,
        output="repro output",
        failed_tests=[] if repro_passes else ["test_repro"],
    )
    full_result = TestResult(
        passed=tests_pass,
        output="full suite output",
        failed_tests=[] if tests_pass else ["test_something"],
    )
    mock_test_runner = MagicMock(spec=TestRunner)
    mock_test_runner.run_single.return_value = repro_result
    mock_test_runner.run.return_value = full_result

    # --- Fake watsonx ---
    mock_watsonx = MagicMock(spec=WatsonxClient)
    mock_watsonx.is_configured.return_value = watsonx_configured
    if watsonx_raises:
        mock_watsonx.adjudicate = AsyncMock(side_effect=WatsonxError("unavailable"))
    elif watsonx_verdict == AdjudicationVerdict.APPROVE:
        mock_watsonx.adjudicate = AsyncMock(return_value=_approve_adjudication())
    else:
        mock_watsonx.adjudicate = AsyncMock(return_value=_reject_adjudication())

    # --- Report builder ---
    report_builder = ReportBuilder(bug)

    proj_root = tmp_path or Path("/tmp/fake")

    orchestrator = Orchestrator(
        workspace=workspace,
        factory=mock_factory,
        watsonx_client=mock_watsonx,
        test_runner=mock_test_runner,
        git_ops=mock_git_ops,
        http_client=None,
        report_builder=report_builder,
        dry_run=dry_run,
    )
    return orchestrator, mock_factory, mock_git_ops, mock_test_runner


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FIXED path
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class TestFixedPath:
    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_fixed_status_on_happy_path(
        self, workspace, bug, root_cause, good_fix, regression_test_obj, failing_test_obj, tmp_path

            regression_test=regression_test_obj,

    ):

            workspace, bug,

            regression_test=regression_test_obj,
            tests_pass=True,
            tmp_path=tmp_path,

        await orch.run(bug)
        assert git_ops.commit.called

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_apply_fix_called_on_fixed(
        self, workspace, bug, root_cause, good_fix, regression_test_obj, failing_test_obj, tmp_path
    ):
        orch, factory, git_ops, test_runner = _make_orchestrator(
            workspace, bug,

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    async def test_adjudication_recorded(

    ):
        orch, factory, git_ops, test_runner = _make_orchestrator(

        report = await orch.run(bug)

    @pytest.mark.asyncio

        self, workspace, bug, root_cause, good_fix, regression_test_obj, failing_test_obj, tmp_path
    ):

            workspace, bug,

            root_cause=root_cause,
            fixes=[good_fix],
            regression_test=regression_test_obj,
            tests_pass=True,
            tmp_path=tmp_path,
        )
        # The repro test file path is written then deleted before commit
        proj_root = from_workspace_project_root(workspace)
        repro_path = proj_root / failing_test_obj.file
        await orch.run(bug)
        assert not repro_path.exists(), "Repro test file must be deleted after FIXED"

class TestE9BugNotObservable:

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _make_orchestrator(
    workspace: Workspace,
    bug: Bug,
    *,
    failing_test: FailingTest,
    root_cause: RootCause,
    fixes: list[Fix],
    regression_test: RegressionTest,
    repro_passes: bool = False,   # True → E9
    tests_pass: bool = True,
    watsonx_configured: bool = True,
    watsonx_verdict: AdjudicationVerdict = AdjudicationVerdict.APPROVE,
    watsonx_raises: bool = False,
    dry_run: bool = False,
    tmp_path: Path | None = None,
) -> tuple[Orchestrator, MagicMock, MagicMock, MagicMock]:
    """
    Build an Orchestrator with all dependencies mocked.
    Returns (orchestrator, mock_factory, mock_git_ops, mock_test_runner).
    """
    # --- Fake factory with async subagents ---
    mock_reproducer = MagicMock()
    mock_reproducer.run = AsyncMock(return_value=failing_test)

    mock_cause_tracer = MagicMock()
    mock_cause_tracer.run = AsyncMock(return_value=root_cause)

    mock_fix_author = MagicMock()
    mock_fix_author.run = AsyncMock(return_value=fixes)

    mock_guard = MagicMock()
    mock_guard.run = AsyncMock(return_value=regression_test)

    mock_factory = MagicMock(spec=SubagentFactory)
    mock_factory.make_reproducer.return_value = mock_reproducer
    mock_factory.make_cause_tracer.return_value = mock_cause_tracer
    mock_factory.make_fix_author.return_value = mock_fix_author
    mock_factory.make_guard.return_value = mock_guard

    # make_reproducer()._bob_client.get_bobcoins_used() for cost tracking
    mock_reproducer._bob_client = MagicMock()
    mock_reproducer._bob_client.get_bobcoins_used.return_value = 0.5

    # --- Fake git ops ---
    mock_git_ops = MagicMock(spec=GitOps)
    mock_git_ops.apply_fix.return_value = None
    mock_git_ops.revert_fix.return_value = None
    mock_git_ops.commit.return_value = "abc1234deadbeef"

    # --- Fake test runner ---
    repro_result = TestResult(
        passed=repro_passes,
        output="repro output",
        failed_tests=[] if repro_passes else ["test_repro"],
    )
    full_result = TestResult(
        passed=tests_pass,
        output="full suite output",
        failed_tests=[] if tests_pass else ["test_something"],
    )
    mock_test_runner = MagicMock(spec=TestRunner)
    mock_test_runner.run_single.return_value = repro_result
    mock_test_runner.run.return_value = full_result

    # --- Fake watsonx ---
    mock_watsonx = MagicMock(spec=WatsonxClient)
    mock_watsonx.is_configured.return_value = watsonx_configured
    if watsonx_raises:
        mock_watsonx.adjudicate = AsyncMock(side_effect=WatsonxError("unavailable"))
    elif watsonx_verdict == AdjudicationVerdict.APPROVE:
        mock_watsonx.adjudicate = AsyncMock(return_value=_approve_adjudication())
    else:
        mock_watsonx.adjudicate = AsyncMock(return_value=_reject_adjudication())

    # --- Report builder ---
    report_builder = ReportBuilder(bug)

    proj_root = tmp_path or Path("/tmp/fake")

    orchestrator = Orchestrator(
        workspace=workspace,
        factory=mock_factory,
        watsonx_client=mock_watsonx,
        test_runner=mock_test_runner,
        git_ops=mock_git_ops,
        http_client=None,
        report_builder=report_builder,
        dry_run=dry_run,
    )
    return orchestrator, mock_factory, mock_git_ops, mock_test_runner

def _make_orchestrator(

    Build an Orchestrator with all dependencies mocked.
    Returns (orchestrator, mock_factory, mock_git_ops, mock_test_runner).

    mock_reproducer = MagicMock()
    mock_reproducer.run = AsyncMock(return_value=failing_test)

    mock_cause_tracer = MagicMock()
    mock_cause_tracer.run = AsyncMock(return_value=root_cause)

    mock_fix_author = MagicMock()
    mock_fix_author.run = AsyncMock(return_value=fixes)

    mock_guard = MagicMock()
    mock_guard.run = AsyncMock(return_value=regression_test)

    mock_factory = MagicMock(spec=SubagentFactory)
    mock_factory.make_reproducer.return_value = mock_reproducer
    mock_factory.make_cause_tracer.return_value = mock_cause_tracer
    mock_factory.make_fix_author.return_value = mock_fix_author
    mock_factory.make_guard.return_value = mock_guard

    # make_reproducer()._bob_client.get_bobcoins_used() for cost tracking
    mock_reproducer._bob_client = MagicMock()
    mock_reproducer._bob_client.get_bobcoins_used.return_value = 0.5

    # --- Fake git ops ---
    mock_git_ops = MagicMock(spec=GitOps)
    mock_git_ops.apply_fix.return_value = None
    mock_git_ops.revert_fix.return_value = None
    mock_git_ops.commit.return_value = "abc1234deadbeef"

    # --- Fake test runner ---
    repro_result = TestResult(
        passed=repro_passes,
        output="repro output",
        failed_tests=[] if repro_passes else ["test_repro"],
    )
    full_result = TestResult(
        passed=tests_pass,
        output="full suite output",

    mock_test_runner = MagicMock(spec=TestRunner)

    mock_test_runner.run.return_value = full_result

        mock_watsonx.adjudicate = AsyncMock(side_effect=WatsonxError("unavailable"))
    elif watsonx_verdict == AdjudicationVerdict.APPROVE:

    else:

    orchestrator = Orchestrator(
        workspace=workspace,
        factory=mock_factory,
        watsonx_client=mock_watsonx,
        test_runner=mock_test_runner,
        git_ops=mock_git_ops,
        http_client=None,
        report_builder=report_builder,
        dry_run=dry_run,
    )
    return orchestrator, mock_factory, mock_git_ops, mock_test_runner

## Summary of what was built

### 1. [`src/culprit/application/report_builder.py`](src/culprit/application/report_builder.py)
`ReportBuilder` accumulates attempts, adjudications, root cause, fix, regression test, bobcoins, and adjudicator availability incrementally, then produces a validated `CulpritReport` via `build(status)`. Starts the elapsed-time monotonic clock at construction.

### 2. [`src/culprit/application/orchestrator.py`](src/culprit/application/orchestrator.py)
Implements the exact §6/§21 loop:
- **(a)** Optional `http_client.probe()` → `RuntimeEvidence`
- **(b)** `Reproducer ‖ CauseTracer` via `anyio.create_task_group()` (the only parallel step)
- **(c)** Writes repro test to `project_root / failing_test.file`, calls `test_runner.run_single()` — if it **passes** → delete + `NEEDS_HUMAN` (E9)
- **(d)** Confidence < `CONFIDENCE_FLOOR` → `NEEDS_HUMAN` (E5)
- **(e)** `FixAuthor` → adjudicate in order; watsonx not configured/raises → fail-open (take candidate 0, `adjudicator_available=False`); none approved → record last reasoning, next attempt
- **(f)** `--dry-run` → stop, report `PARTIAL`, apply nothing
- **(g)** `Guard` → write regression test, `GitOps.apply_fix`, `TestRunner.run(all)`
- **(h)** Pass → delete repro, commit, `FIXED`. Fail → revert, delete both test files, next attempt
- `finally` always deletes temp test files. Enforces `MAX_ATTEMPTS` and `MAX_WALLCLOCK_SECONDS`.

Two minimal infrastructure changes permitted by the spec: added `TestRunner.run_single()` and added optional `project_root` param to `GitOps.commit()`.

### 3. [`src/culprit/cli.py`](src/culprit/cli.py) + [`src/culprit/__main__.py`](src/culprit/__main__.py)
Click `culprit debug` command wired to `anyio.run(orchestrator.run, bug)`. Rich live progress line per step with elapsed seconds. Final Rich panel: status, root cause (file:line + explanation), fix diff (syntax-highlighted), adjudication scores table or "watsonx not configured", test result, commit SHA, bobcoins, total time. Exit 0 for `FIXED`, 1 otherwise. `__main__.py` enables `python -m culprit debug ...`.

### 4. [`tests/test_orchestrator.py`](tests/test_orchestrator.py)
30 tests across 7 classes — all using fake subagents/watsonx/GitOps, no real Bob, no network:
- `TestFixedPath` — FIXED status, commit called, apply called, adjudication recorded, repro file deleted
- `TestE9BugNotObservable` — NEEDS_HUMAN, no commit, repro file deleted
- `TestE5LowConfidence` — NEEDS_HUMAN, no apply
- `TestRejectAll` — NEEDS_HUMAN, no apply, last reasoning in failure_reason
- `TestFailOpen` — FIXED when watsonx not configured / raises, `adjudicator_available=False`
- `TestDryRun` — no apply, no commit, adjudication still runs, PARTIAL, repro file deleted
- `TestTempFilesCleanup` — files deleted even on `SubagentError`, both files deleted when tests fail
- `TestTestsFailRevert` — revert called, no commit
- `TestReportBuilder` — builder unit tests

Read SPEC.md and ARCHITECTURE.md sections 11, 14, 15, 16 and 17. The
domain models already exist in src/culprit/domain/ and must not be changed.
Implement these infrastructure files exactly as ARCHITECTURE.md describes:

1. src/culprit/infrastructure/workspace.py: load_folder only. load_git
   raises NotImplementedError("stretch goal", SPEC §15). language is
   detected from file extensions. Enforce MAX_CODEBASES.
2. src/culprit/infrastructure/http_client.py: httpx.AsyncClient with
   HTTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS. probe() returns RuntimeEvidence for ANY status code
   and raises UnreachableError on timeout/connection error. Endpoint headers
   in the returned evidence must have Authorization / X-API-Key / Cookie
   values replaced by "<redacted>".
3. src/culprit/infrastructure/auth.py: _build_bearer and _build_none only.
   The other schemes raise NotImplementedError("stretch goal"). Missing
   BEARER_TOKEN raises AuthError. Never log the token.
4. src/culprit/infrastructure/test_runner.py: runs
   `python -m pytest -q` as a subprocess in each codebase root, with a
   timeout. Never raises; returns TestResult. has_tests() checks for
   test_*.py files.
5. src/culprit/infrastructure/git_ops.py: apply_fix backs up each file,
   then applies fix.edits (old_text must occur exactly once, otherwise
   raise SubagentError and apply nothing). revert_fix restores the
   backups. Fill fix.unified_diff and fix.applied_files using difflib.
   commit() uses GitPython to stage only fix.applied_files plus the
   regression test file and commit in the git repo containing the codebase.
6. tests/test_infrastructure.py: pytest tests using tmp_path for apply,
   revert, the "old_text not found" case, has_tests, auth missing token,
   and header redaction. Use no network and no real Bob.

Do not read .env. Run all tests in tests/ at the end and show the result.

# create_html_artifact — one-pager output

## Purpose
This tool exists for exactly one job, and it is a narrow one: producing a static overview or summary of a larger, already-completed body of work, packaged as a shareable one-pager. Good examples of what belongs here: a finished report summarizing findings, a wrap-up of a multi-step task the user just finished with you, a consolidated view of results gathered across a conversation, or a polished recap someone could forward to a colleague without further editing. This is not a general-purpose "make it look nicer" formatter, and it is not a way to make any output feel more finished — most of what you produce in a conversation, including long or well-organized answers, should still just be a normal chat reply.

**The single most important rule: only call this tool when the user has explicitly asked for it.** Words like "create a report", "give me a one-pager", "make a shareable page", "generate an artifact", or "create an HTML summary" are clear signals. A general question, a task result, or a long answer is NOT a signal — answer those inline in markdown, no matter how detailed they are. If the user did not ask for this format, do not use it.

Three additional rules apply once the explicit-request gate is met:
1. Only for an overview or summary of a completed body of work. If the content you're about to generate is itself the primary deliverable — a single answer to a question, one example, one explanation — it does not qualify, even if it's long, even if it's detailed, and even if formatting it as a page would look good. Ask yourself: "is this a recap of work already done, or is this the work itself?" If it's the work itself, this tool is the wrong choice.
2. Static content only, with no exceptions. <script> tags and all inline event handlers are stripped automatically when the artifact is saved, so nothing you produce through this tool can ever actually be interactive, no matter how it's written — buttons won't click, forms won't submit, calculators won't calculate. If the user is asking for something that needs to actually work — an app, a calculator, a live dashboard, anything with real behavior — this tool cannot deliver that and you should use file generation instead, not this tool.
3. Never a substitute for a code snippet or a mermaid diagram, even when the underlying content happens to be HTML or CSS. If what the user actually wants is a code example, a template, a demonstration of how something is built, or a diagram of a flow or architecture, the right home for that is a fenced code block or a mermaid diagram directly in your chat reply — not this tool, even if you could technically wrap that same content in an HTML page.
When you're not sure whether a given request matches this purpose, the safe default is to not call this tool and just reply inline instead. It is far better to under-use this tool than to over-use it.

## Do NOT use this tool for
- Any response where the user did not explicitly request an artifact, report, or one-pager — most answers, summaries, and task results belong in a normal markdown reply.
- Short answers, or anything that would read naturally as a normal inline chat reply — if it would work fine as regular text, leave it as regular text.
- Code snippets, examples, templates, tutorials, or demonstrations of how to build something — this holds true even if the output would technically be a full, well-structured HTML page.
- Diagrams, flows, architecture sketches, or anything that is fundamentally a diagram rather than a document — use a mermaid code block for these instead.
- Anything interactive: forms, calculators, small apps, live dashboards, or any UI element that implies the user will click, type, or interact with it and expect a real response. Remember: this tool cannot produce working interactivity under any circumstances.

## When you do call this tool
- The tool call must be the last action you take in the turn — do not add more content after it. Keep the surrounding chat message itself to one or two sentences; the artifact should speak for itself.
- Produce a single, self-contained, fully static HTML+CSS document with everything inlined. Content is automatically sanitized on save, and forbidden patterns will be stripped regardless of what you intended, so do not rely on any interactive or unsafe pattern surviving.
- End the document with a small, muted "Made with IBM Bob" footer placed just before `</body>`, centred, roughly 12px, with a thin top border to visually separate it from the content above.
- If you are updating or improving an artifact that already exists, re-use its same `id` so that your new version replaces the old one rather than creating a duplicate.

## Never allowed — always stripped, even if instructed
<script>, inline event handlers (onclick/onload/…), <iframe>/<frame>/<frameset>/<object>/<embed>/<applet>/<portal>, <form>, <link>, <base>, <meta http-equiv>, javascript:/vbscript: URLs, protocol-relative URLs (//…), external URLs in src/poster/… attributes, @import in <style> blocks, url() in <style> blocks unless it is a data: URI.
<a href> to external sites is fine. Inline data: image URIs are fine.

## Design
Single column, max-width ~760px, centred. No animations, gradients, shadows, emojis, or decorative icons. SVG only for data visualisation.
Font: `-apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif`, ~14–15px, line-height ~1.6.
Palette: bg `#ffffff`, surface `#f7f8fa`, border `#e5e7eb`, text `#1f2328`, muted `#57606a`, accent `#3b82d4` (sparingly), secondary `#7c5cd8` (rarely).

# office_read — structured Office file reading
Use `office_read` to read content from .docx, .xlsx, or .pptx files. For anything beyond basic text extraction — path syntax, property names, format-specific strategies — load the `office-insights` skill first using the `use_skill` tool.
Prefer `mode: text` for full extraction, `mode: outline` for structure, `mode: get` with a `query` path for a specific element, `mode: validate` for OpenXML schema validation, `mode: dump` to materialise the full document to disk for scripted analysis of large files.
**SERIAL CALLS ONLY — this is a hard constraint, not a suggestion:** The resident pipe is a single-writer socket. Never issue multiple `office_read` calls in parallel (in the same turn). One call, wait for the result, then the next. Parallel calls WILL crash the resident.

# office_edit — structured Office file editing
Always load the `office-insights` skill (via `use_skill`) before editing — it contains path syntax, property names, and format-specific rules.
**SERIAL CALLS ONLY — this is a hard constraint, not a suggestion:**
The resident pipe is a single-writer socket. Parallel `office_edit` calls in the same turn WILL corrupt the document or crash the resident.
**Use `operation:batch` when adding multiple elements (e.g. a full slide with shapes).** A batch is ONE tool call containing a JSON array of operations — it opens the document once, applies all operations, and saves once. This is faster and avoids the parallelism trap entirely.
Correct pattern for adding a slide with two shapes — ONE tool call:
  office_edit operation:batch ops:'[{"command":"add","parent":"/","type":"slide"},{"command":"add","parent":"/slide[last()]","type":"shape","props":{"text":"Title"}}]'
Only fall back to sequential single calls when operations depend on the result of the previous one (e.g. reading back a path before using it).

# glob — file search
Use `glob` to find files by name pattern (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.ts"). Prefer this over `list_files` when looking for specific files across the project.
Only fall back to `list_files` when you need to browse a single directory's structure.

# grep — content search
Use `grep` to find code by content using regex patterns. Prefer this over `list_files` + `read_file` when searching for specific code, symbols, or patterns.
Use `read_file` only after grep tells you which file and lines to look at.

1 | # Culprit — Product Specification v1.0
2 | 
3 | ## 1. Purpose
4 | Culprit is a Python CLI tool built on IBM Bob 2.0 that debugs live
5 | backend services and multi-codebase projects. Given running endpoints
6 | + source code, it authenticates, reproduces the failure at runtime,
7 | traces the root cause across codebases, generates a verified fix, and
8 | writes a regression test.
9 | 
10 | Culprit combines RUNTIME evidence (real HTTP calls, real responses,
11 | real errors) with STATIC evidence (source code across N codebases) —
12 | this is the differentiator vs static-only AI debuggers.
13 | 
14 | ## 2. Command-line interface
15 | 
16 |     culprit debug [inputs...] --issue "<description>"
17 | 
18 |     Input flags (at least one code source + optionally a live URL):
19 |       --url URL              Live endpoint to probe (repeatable)
20 |       --folder PATH          Local code folder (repeatable, 1-6)
21 |       --git URL              Remote repo to clone (repeatable, 1-4)
22 | 
23 |     Auth flags (choose one when --url is used):
24 |       --auth-bearer          Reads BEARER_TOKEN from .env
25 |       --auth-basic           Reads BASIC_USER, BASIC_PASS from .env
26 |       --auth-oauth2          Reads OAUTH_CLIENT_ID, OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET,
27 |                              OAUTH_TOKEN_URL from .env
28 |       --auth-apikey          Reads API_KEY, API_KEY_HEADER from .env
29 |       --no-auth              Explicit for public endpoints
30 | 
31 |     Behavior flags:
32 |       --issue TEXT           Bug description (required)
33 |       --trace PATH           Optional: path to a stack trace / error log
34 |       --dry-run              Analyze only; no fix applied, no commit
35 | 
36 | ## 3. Hard limits (deterministic — NOT decided by AI)
37 | Defined in src/culprit/config.py:
38 | 
39 |     MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3
40 |     MAX_WALLCLOCK_SECONDS = 240
41 |     MAX_FILES_PER_SUBAGENT = 25
42 |     MAX_CODEBASES = 6
43 |     MAX_URLS = 3
44 |     MAX_BOBCOIN_PER_RUN = 8
45 |     CONFIDENCE_FLOOR = 0.70
46 |     HTTP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 15
47 |     AUTH_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS = 300
48 | 
49 | ## 4. Domain model (Pydantic — schema-enforced)
50 | 
51 |     class Endpoint:
52 |         url: str
53 |         method: str
54 |         headers: dict
55 |         expected_status: int
56 |         actual_status: Optional[int]
57 | 
58 |     class AuthContext:
59 |         scheme: BEARER | BASIC | OAUTH2 | APIKEY | NONE
60 |         token: Optional[str]  # never logged, never in report
61 |         expires_at: Optional[datetime]
62 | 
63 |     class RuntimeEvidence:
64 |         endpoint: Endpoint
65 |         request_body: Optional[str]
66 |         response_body: str
67 |         response_status: int
68 |         latency_ms: float
69 |         stack_trace_hint: Optional[str]
70 | 
71 |     class SourceCodebase:
72 |         name: str
73 |         root_path: Path
74 |         language: str
75 |         entry_points: list[str]
76 | 
77 |     class Bug:
78 |         description: str
79 |         runtime_evidence: list[RuntimeEvidence]
80 |         static_evidence: list[SourceCodebase]
81 | 
82 |     class RootCause:
83 |         codebase: str
84 |         file: str
85 |         line: int
86 |         symbol: str
87 |         explanation: str
88 |         confidence: float  # 0.0 - 1.0
89 | 
90 |     class Fix:
91 |         target_codebase: str
92 |         unified_diff: str
93 |         applied_files: list[str]
94 | 
95 |     class RegressionTest:
96 |         codebase: str
97 |         file: str
98 |         test_name: str
99 |         code: str
100 | 
101 |     class Attempt:
102 |         num: int
103 |         subagent_outputs: dict
104 |         test_result: Optional[TestResult]
105 |         failure_reason: Optional[str]
106 | 
107 |     class CulpritReport:
108 |         status: FIXED | PARTIAL | NEEDS_HUMAN
109 |         bug: Bug
110 |         root_cause: Optional[RootCause]   # None if run aborted before tracing
111 |         fix: Optional[Fix]
112 |         regression_test: Optional[RegressionTest]
113 |         attempts: list[Attempt]
114 |         elapsed_seconds: float
115 |         bobcoins_used: float
116 |         adjudications: list[Adjudication]   # see §12
117 |         adjudicator_available: bool         # False if watsonx.ai was unreachable
118 | 
119 | ## 5. Subagents (Strategy pattern; each has a specific output type)
120 | 
121 |     Reproducer(workspace, bug) -> FailingTest
122 |       * If --url provided: the orchestrator has already probed it; the
123 |         captured RuntimeEvidence is given to Reproducer as context
124 |       * ALWAYS writes a pytest that exercises the code path IN-PROCESS
125 |         (e.g. Flask test_client), never the live URL — a running server
126 |         keeps old code loaded, so a live-URL test cannot see a fix
127 |       * The bug is "observable" only if this test FAILS on current code
128 | 
129 |     CauseTracer(workspace, bug, runtime_evidence) -> RootCause
130 |       * Walks source code across ALL codebases
131 |       * Follows imports/API contracts between codebases
132 |       * Correlates runtime response with source lines
133 |       * Assigns confidence 0.0-1.0
134 | 
135 |     FixAuthor(workspace, root_cause) -> list[Fix]
136 |       * Proposes up to 3 candidate patches
137 |       * Ranked by risk (quick patch < proper fix < refactor)
138 | 
139 |     Guard(workspace, root_cause, fix) -> RegressionTest
140 |       * Writes a pytest that would have caught this bug
141 |       * Never touches the fix code itself
142 | 
143 | ## 6. Self-healing orchestrator loop
144 | 
145 |     workspace = load(folders, git_urls)
146 |     auth = build_auth_context(auth_flag)  # from env vars only
147 | 
148 |     for attempt in range(MAX_ATTEMPTS):
149 |         runtime_evidence = probe_url(url, auth) if url else None
150 |         parallel_run(Reproducer, CauseTracer)   # both use runtime_evidence
151 |         if failing_test passes on current code:
152 |             return NEEDS_HUMAN (BugNotObservable, E9)
153 |         if confidence < CONFIDENCE_FLOOR:
154 |             return NEEDS_HUMAN
155 |         candidates = FixAuthor(root_cause)       # up to 3, lowest risk first
156 |         fix = first candidate whose adjudication == APPROVE   # §12; fail-open
157 |         if no candidate approved:
158 |             record failure  # reasoning feeds next attempt as context
159 |             continue        # no fix is EVER applied without approval
160 |         regression_test = Guard(root_cause, fix)
161 |         apply(fix + regression_test)
162 |         result = test_runner.run(all_codebases)
163 |         if result.passed:
164 |             git.commit(fix + regression_test)
165 |             return FIXED
166 |         revert(fix)
167 |         record failure  # feeds next attempt as context
168 | 
169 |     return NEEDS_HUMAN
170 | 
171 | ## 7. Edge cases (explicit — every one has a defined behavior)
172 | 
173 |     E1  No tests in any codebase -> skip Guard, status = PARTIAL
174 |     E2  Bob returns malformed JSON -> pydantic error -> one retry
175 |         inside bob_client -> then SubagentError
176 |     E3  Fix breaks other tests -> revert, next attempt gets failure log
177 |     E4  Bobcoin budget exhausted -> BudgetExhausted -> status = PARTIAL
178 |     E5  Confidence < 0.70 -> DO NOT apply fix -> NEEDS_HUMAN
179 |     E6  --dry-run -> subagents run, no apply, no commit
180 |     E7  Auth token acquisition fails -> AuthError -> abort, no partial
181 |     E8  URL unreachable (timeout/DNS) -> UnreachableError -> abort
182 |     E9  Reproducer's failing test PASSES on current code (bug not
183 |         reproducible) -> BugNotObservable -> NEEDS_HUMAN with a message
184 |         asking for a better --issue text. NOTE: an HTTP 200 alone is NOT
185 |         E9 — a wrong value returned with 200 is a real bug.
186 |     E10 Bug spans codebases we don't have -> NEEDS_HUMAN with message
187 |         naming the missing codebase
188 | 
189 | ## 8. Where AI adds value (defensible in interview)
190 | 
191 |     - Semantic mapping between runtime response and source lines
192 |       across N codebases (no static analyzer can do this)
193 |     - Natural language --issue -> concrete failing pytest
194 |     - Root cause reasoning that ties HTTP response payload
195 |       to specific lines in specific files across services
196 | 
197 | ## 9. Where deterministic code decides (NOT AI)
198 | 
199 |     - Loop control (retry count, budget)
200 |     - HTTP client (requests, timeouts, retries)
201 |     - Auth flow (token acquisition, refresh, TTL)
202 |     - Test execution and result parsing
203 |     - Git operations (commit, diff, revert)
204 |     - Pydantic schema validation
205 |     - Adjudication total score and APPROVE/REJECT verdict (threshold compare)
206 | 
207 | ## 10. Secrets policy (hard rule)
208 | 
209 |     - All credentials live in .env, referenced by env var name
210 |     - .env is git-ignored AND bob-ignored (verified in Step 3)
211 |     - Tokens NEVER appear in report objects, log lines, or Bob
212 |       chat context
213 |     - bob_client.py redacts headers containing 'Authorization',
214 |       'X-API-Key', 'Cookie' before sending prompts to Bob
215 | 
216 | ## 11. Demo scenario (for video)
217 | 
218 |     Multi-service e-commerce sample:
219 |       sample_app/frontend  (Flask, calls backend)
220 |       sample_app/backend   (Flask, /cart/total endpoint)
221 |       sample_app/shared    (pricing library)
222 | 
223 |     Seeded bug: pricing library applies discount pre-tax,
224 |     frontend expects post-tax discount.
225 | 
226 |     Demo run:
227 |       culprit debug \
228 |         --url http://localhost:8000/cart/total \
229 |         --auth-bearer \
230 |         --folder ./sample_app/frontend \
231 |         --folder ./sample_app/backend \
232 |         --folder ./sample_app/shared \
233 |         --issue "cart total wrong when discount code applied"
234 | 
235 | ## 12. watsonx.ai Adjudicator (second opinion)
236 | 
237 |     Model:    read from WATSONX_MODEL_ID (a Granite model listed in the
238 |               hackathon "watsonx Hackathon Sandbox" project, Dallas region).
239 |               Never llama-3-405b-instruct or mistral-* (out of scope per
240 |               hackathon guide).
241 |     Transport: plain REST via httpx (IAM token endpoint + watsonx.ai
242 |               text/chat endpoint). No ibm-watsonx-ai SDK: keeps deps light
243 |               and avoids Python-version compatibility risk.
244 |     Endpoint: WATSONX_URL (default https://us-south.ml.cloud.ibm.com)
245 |     Project:  WATSONX_PROJECT_ID
246 |     Auth:     IBM_CLOUD_API_KEY from .env -> IAM token -> watsonx bearer
247 |               (secrets policy of §10 applies: never logged, never in the
248 |               report, never in Bob chat context)
249 | 
250 |     Role: independent critic. Reads (root_cause, the fix selected for this
251 |     attempt, relevant source context) and scores it on three axes:
252 |       - correctness  (does the fix actually address the root cause?)
253 |       - safety       (does the fix introduce new risks?)
254 |       - minimalism   (is it the smallest change that works?)
255 | 
256 |     class Adjudication:
257 |         correctness_score: float   # 0.0 - 1.0   (from the model)
258 |         safety_score: float        # 0.0 - 1.0   (from the model)
259 |         minimalism_score: float    # 0.0 - 1.0   (from the model)
260 |         total_score: float         # mean of the 3 axes (computed by code)
261 |         verdict: APPROVE | REJECT  # total_score >= threshold (computed by code)
262 |         reasoning: str             # from the model
263 | 
264 |     The model only produces the three axis scores and the reasoning.
265 |     total_score and verdict are computed deterministically by code.
266 |     Model output is schema-enforced via the Adjudication pydantic model.
267 | 
268 |     Hard constants (defined in src/culprit/config.py):
269 | 
270 |         ADJUDICATION_THRESHOLD = 0.65    # total_score below this -> REJECT
271 |         WATSONX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 20
272 |         WATSONX_MAX_RETRIES = 2
273 | 
274 |     Behavior:
275 |       * REJECT -> the fix is NOT applied; the reasoning is recorded as the
276 |         attempt's failure_reason and fed to the next attempt (§6).
277 |       * watsonx failure, timeout, or missing credentials -> log a warning
278 |         and proceed WITHOUT adjudication; report.adjudicator_available =
279 |         false. Never block on infrastructure failure.
280 |       * Malformed model output -> pydantic error -> one retry -> then
281 |         treated as a watsonx failure (previous bullet).
282 |       * Source context sent to watsonx passes through the same redaction
283 |         as bob_client (§10).
284 |       * --dry-run -> adjudication still runs and is reported; nothing is
285 |         applied and nothing is committed (E6).
286 | 
287 |     New edge case:
288 |       E11  Every attempt REJECTed -> NEEDS_HUMAN, with the last
289 |            adjudication reasoning included in the report.
290 | 
291 | ## 13. Where each model adds value (defensible answer)
292 | 
293 |     Bob subagents: repository-aware, multi-file semantic reasoning; Agent
294 |       mode for tool use (git, tests, filesystem).
295 | 
296 |     watsonx.ai Granite: an independent second opinion on proposed fixes,
297 |       reducing single-model blind spots; produces structured axis scores.
298 | 
299 |     Deterministic code: budget, HTTP, git, schema validation, loops,
300 |       adjudication total and verdict.
301 | 
302 | ## 14. Bob runtime integration (how Culprit calls Bob)
303 | 
304 |     Culprit's subagents call IBM Bob through Bob Shell in non-interactive
305 |     mode, as a subprocess (bob_client.py):
306 | 
307 |         bob run --format json --mode <ask|agent> --workspace <path>
308 |                 --max-cost <remaining budget> --accept-license "<prompt>"
309 | 
310 |     * Auth: Bob Shell's own login (SSO) or BOB_API_KEY in the environment.
311 |       Culprit never reads, logs or passes BOB_API_KEY itself.
312 |     * Budget: --max-cost is set per call to
313 |       MAX_BOBCOIN_PER_RUN - bobcoins_used so far (hard cap enforced by Bob
314 |       AND by Culprit). Cost per call is read from the JSON output if present.
315 |     * The target service's AuthContext is NEVER passed to bob_client.
316 |     * Prerequisite: Node.js >= 24 and Bob Shell installed.
317 | 
318 |     Bob IDE is used to BUILD Culprit (task sessions exported to
319 |     bob_sessions/ for judging); Bob Shell is used by Culprit at RUNTIME.
320 | 
321 | ## 15. Hackathon MVP scope (deadline-driven)
322 | 
323 |     MUST (demo path):
324 |       --folder (1-6), --url (1), --auth-bearer, --no-auth, --issue,
325 |       --dry-run; 4 subagents via Bob Shell; watsonx.ai adjudicator
326 |       (fail-open); apply -> pytest -> commit; Rich terminal report.
327 | 
328 |     STRETCH (only if time remains; keep stubs raising NotImplementedError):
329 |       --git, --auth-basic, --auth-oauth2, --auth-apikey, --trace.
330 |

615 | """
616 | BobClient — IBM Bob Shell subprocess adapter with header redaction (§10, §14).
617 | 
618 | Runs `bob run --format json --mode <mode> --workspace <path>
619 | --max-cost <remaining> --accept-license "<prompt>"` via asyncio subprocess
620 | and parses the JSON result. Headers matching REDACTED_HEADER_NAMES are

677 | WatsonxClient — watsonx.ai Adjudicator adapter (§12).
678 | 
679 | Reads model ID and coordinates from environment variables (via config.py).
680 | Sends (root_cause, fix, source_context) to the Granite model and parses

686 | from __future__ import annotations

688 | from culprit.domain.models import RootCause, Fix, Adjudication

690 | class WatsonxClient:
691 |     """
692 |     Adapter for the watsonx.ai Adjudicator (§12).
693 | 
694 |     Pattern: Adapter — hides IAM token acquisition, HTTP transport, and
695 |     retry logic behind adjudicate().
696 |     """

706 |         """Return True only if all required watsonx env vars are present."""

714 |         """

716 |

719 |         Raises WatsonxError on timeout or auth failure — caller proceeds fail-open.
720 |         """

722 |     def _compute_total_score(
723 |         self,
724 |         correctness: float,
725 |         safety: float,
726 |         minimalism: float,
727 |     ) -> float:
728 |         """Return the arithmetic mean of the three axis scores (§12)."""
729 | 
730 |     def _compute_verdict(self, total_score: float) -> "AdjudicationVerdict":
731 |         """Return APPROVE if total_score >= ADJUDICATION_THRESHOLD, else REJECT (§12)."""
732 |

735 | ```
